label: At most one actual CONCRETE_6 root, from De ente's other cause and one own esse
meaning: The uniqueness half of ACTUAL-ROOT-UNIQUENESS (0edb19eb), with its genus principle at being and fixed-esse grades replaced by De ente's stages: the #1629 step 457698e4 (another actual cause of being, mode unspecified; with existing-in-act 0436de86 and the mode-unspecified esse-cause bridge cb1cdea9 it gives every actual concrete root esse equal to essence) and at most one actual being whose esse is its essence. No root is said to exist; necessity and God identification do not follow; no efficient cause is used or concluded. Its composition with root existence into 7ab0ddcb is registered in specs/de-ente-root-interface-1635.toml (#1635), after the sense links of 5c898d24 and 7ab0ddcb were trimmed to the constants their Lean types use.
